sn47.24:1.2: “Bhikkhus, there are these four establishments of mindfulness.
sn47.24:1.4: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.24:1.5: He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings …
sn47.24:1.7: phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.24:1.8: These are the four establishments of mindfulness.”
